name: Glute Bridge
summary: A fundamental bodyweight exercise performed lying supine that targets the glutes and posterior chain through hip extension.

setup: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, roughly hip-width apart and six to ten inches from your glutes.
Rest your arms along your sides with palms facing down for stability.
steps: Brace your core and drive down through your heels to raise your hips off the floor.
Extend your hips until your thighs, pelvis, and torso form a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Contract your glutes forcefully at the top and hold for a brief pause or the target duration.
Lower your hips under control back to the floor to complete the repetition.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you press through your heels and raise your hips; inhale as you lower back down.
cues: Squeeze glutes, don't arch lower back.
Maintain a straight line from knees to shoulders.

common_faults.fault: Hyperextending the lumbar spine at the peak of the movement.
common_faults.correction: Stop lifting when your hips are in a straight line with your knees and shoulders, keeping your ribcage locked down with braced abdominals.

common_faults.fault: Pushing predominantly through the toes, shifting tension to the quadriceps.
common_faults.correction: Keep your entire foot planted with primary pressure through your heels to maximize glute and hamstring recruitment.

common_faults.fault: Allowing the knees to collapse inward during the ascent.
common_faults.correction: Keep your knees tracking directly over your mid-toes throughout the entire range of motion.

precautions: Avoid over-arching the lower back to achieve perceived extra height at the top.
